d:
Love AI? You'll love this. Hate AI? You'll love to hate this. Either way, you're watching a man ride an inflatable horse into a gunfight armed with a slingshot.
Stream "Red Dead Reckoning": [LINK]
Let's get it out of the way. Yes, the video is made with AI. No, we're not sorry. The song, though, is 100% human: real riffs, real vocals, recorded and mixed the old-fashioned way. The AI just handled the horses we couldn't afford and the town we weren't allowed to blow up. Tell us in the comments which side of the saloon you're on. We read them all, even the mean ones. Especially the mean ones.
